environment_evidence: Confirmed by owner in this conversation on 2026-09-14
scope: Metadata SELECTs and read-only inventory/advisor tools only. No application rows, auth accounts, keys or secrets retrieved. No production writes.

lints.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.

findings.detail: Function `public.rls_auto_enable()` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/rls_auto_enable`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

lints.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.

findings.detail: Function `public.rls_auto_enable()` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/rls_auto_enable`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

limitations: Inventory calls were separate observations, not a transactionally consistent database snapshot or a backup.
Non-platform relation query excluded named platform schemas; empty result does not assert whole database has no objects or data.
Metadata access through MCP does not verify app login, browser API access, RLS allow/deny, rollback or business workflows.
Advisor observed_at timestamps are provider values, not evidence that a fresh full security scan ran.
The combined schema/default privilege query returned only its last result set; schema privileges were obtained by a separate SELECT.
No DEV environment, Apps Script backends, sync job, headers or anonymized production samples were available.
Initial frontend characterization results in phase-0-audit.md were not rerun; source hashes matched.
